blocks.heading: Bombora cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Bombora against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.body: Budget risk: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
